name: morvin
author: sport-and-scoring agent
description: Ten-pin bowling frames. Clue: `<digits>/<n>`, 3-5 digits each 1-9 = how many pins were knocked down in that frame, and n in 0..12. Solution: 5 lines. Line 1 is the clue digits (one token per frame); lines 2-5 are the pin decks of the frames side by side, one rack per frame drawn as a 4/3/2/1 triangle with the head pin (nearest the bowler) on the LAST line: `o` = pin standing, `.` = pin knocked down. Frame k must have exactly digit-k dots. THE RULE: exactly n pins in the whole picture must have fallen although EVERY pin immediately in front of them is still standing ('in front' = the one or two pins of the next row toward the head pin; the head pin itself has none and never counts). PRIVATE discovery path: one demo shows a bowling rack and the digits are the dot counts, so the whole difficulty is what n counts. Foothold: on 23% of clues n=0, and n=0 forces every fallen pin to have a fallen pin in front of it, i.e. exactly the physical answer 'the ball took the front pins first' - that natural first probe scores 100% on those clues and 21% overall, which tells a player that n counts pins that fell out of turn. Rivals falsified in every shipped demo (hard filter in solve): the EXISTS reading (fallen with SOME pin in front standing), the MIRROR reading (fallen with every pin BEHIND standing), the complement (standing pins with all pins in front fallen); soft-filtered (at most one may coincide): isolated fallen, standing-with-all-behind-fallen, back-row fallen, head pins down, cleared rows, isolated standing, total fallen, frame count, standing total, frames with/without a ghost. generate() never lets n equal the frame count, the pin total or the standing total. Demo guarantees (91% of demos): a counted pin with TWO standing pins in front of it, a counted pin in the row right behind a standing head pin (kills the 'back rows only' reading), a near miss (a fallen pin with one standing and one fallen pin in front), a fallen pin with everything in front of it down, at least one frame with no counted pin, one frame with >=2, the head pin down in some frames and up in others. Measured witnesses (800 fresh clues): random legal racks 10.8%, front-first 21.4%, reading-order (top of the drawing first) 3.5%, connected blob from the head pin 18.2%, EXISTS reading 30.9%, MIRROR 7.9%, front-OR-back 29.0%, back-two-rows-only 25.2%, frames-with-a-ghost 25.0%, isolated fallen 8.0%, complement 9.6%, back-row fallen 8.8%, cleared rows 6.2%, best N-blind per-digit template 26.0%, previous demo patched to the new dot counts 2.0%, one fixed answer 0.1%, demo replay 0.0%, the true rule 100%. 202 hand-built local-neighbourhood statistics: 2 survive 3 demos and they are the same rule stated two ways.
